business.name: Fixture Fence Co
business.tagline: Fences, gates, and repairs across East Texas
hours: Mon to Fri 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM

offer.headline: A straight fence, a fair number, and a crew that shows up.
offer.subhead: Wood, chain link, and ranch fencing built and repaired in Longview and the towns around it. Get a written quote within one business day.
offer.promise: Three things every customer asks before they call, answered on this page.
offer.trustLine: Licensed and insured. Written quotes, no surprises on the invoice.

sections.title: What it costs
sections.body: Every quote is in writing and itemised: materials, labor, and haul-away. The price on the quote is the price on the invoice.

sections.title: When we can start
sections.body: Most residential jobs start within two weeks of a signed quote. We tell you the date before you sign.

sections.title: What happens if something breaks
sections.body: One year on workmanship. Call the number on this page and a person answers.

services.intro: Residential and light commercial fencing, built to last in East Texas weather.

items.name: Wood privacy fences
items.description: Six and eight foot cedar or pine, post-set in concrete, with gates to match.
items.startingAt: Quoted per foot after a site visit

items.name: Chain link and ranch fencing
items.description: Yards, pastures, and commercial lots. Galvanised or vinyl-coated.

items.name: Gates and repairs
items.description: Sagging gates, storm damage, rotted posts. Same crew, same written quote.

about.story: Fixture Fence Co is a fictional example business used to demonstrate a five-page site built by The LeadFlow Pro factory. Nothing on this site describes a real company.

people.name: Sam Fixture
people.bio: Runs the crew and answers the phone.

contact.intro: Call, text, or send the quote form. A person replies within one business day.

conversion.title: Get a written quote
conversion.intro: Tell us the job and where it is. We will call to set a site visit and send the quote within one business day of seeing it.
